assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.empty: Ask me anything about your business.
assistant.askOwner: Ask whoever runs the business to upgrade the plan.
assistant.usage: You have {left} of {limit} messages left this month.
assistant.usageSpent: You have used all {limit} messages of this month.
assistant.offline: No connection: you can write, and send when it is back.

files.tooLarge: {name} is too large: 8 MB at most per file.
files.tooMuch: The files of one question add up to 20 MB at most.
files.unsupported: {name} cannot be attached: images, PDF, Word, Excel, text or CSV.

voice.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser to dictate.
voice.deniedInApp: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your device settings to dictate.
voice.failed: The audio could not be transcribed. Try again.
voice.tooLong: The recording is too long: dictate a shorter message.
voice.empty: Nothing was heard. Try again closer to the microphone.

errors.unreachable: The assistant could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unavailable: The assistant is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.quotaSpent: You have used all the assistant's messages of this month ({used} of {limit}).
errors.noPlan: Your plan does not include the assistant.
errors.rateLimited: Too many questions in a row: wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.tooLarge: This conversation is too long: start a new one.
errors.tooManySteps: I stopped: this needed too many steps. Ask for it in parts.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to keep talking.

notices.claimed_change: The assistant said it made a change, but no action was run. Nothing was changed.
notices.unread_id: This answer shows an identifier the assistant did not really read. Do not trust it.
notices.unknown_screen: This answer points to a screen that does not exist here.

card.title: Run this action?
card.highMessage: {action} in {app}. Check each datum before going on.
card.notFromChat: I cannot tell how many records this would change, so I do not do it from here. Open its screen, where you can see them.

report.title: Report this answer
report.intro: If this answer of the assistant looks wrong or harmful, send it to us and we will review it.

reasons.instructions: It did not do what I asked

report.sent: Thank you, we have received your report.
report.failed: The report could not be sent. Try again.
